title: Lead Administrator - Network LAN/WAN mgmt
description:
Lead Administrator \- Network LAN/WAN mgmt
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


This role is responsible for managing and resolving advanced LAN/WAN network issues, ensuring operational stability and security for critical business functions. The individual will facilitate root cause analysis, mentor team members, and drive improvements in support processes to enhance customer satisfaction and protect organizational assets.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Troubleshoot and resolve complex LAN/WAN connectivity and performance issues using advanced network diagnostic tools, ensuring minimal business disruption.
  

2\. Implement and maintain ITIL\-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management within LAN/WAN environments, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy standards.
  

3\. Conduct root cause analysis for escalated network incidents and execute remediation strategies to prevent recurrence and strengthen network resilience.
  

4\. Proactively monitor network infrastructure using platforms such as SolarWinds or Cisco Prime, identifying security vulnerabilities and coordinating prompt mitigation actions.
  

5\. Maintain and update comprehensive network documentation and knowledge bases, supporting efficient operations and knowledge transfer within the team.
  

6\. Mentor and deliver technical training to team members and new joiners on LAN/WAN management best practices, fostering skill development and productivity.
  

7\. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, and secure resolution of network\-related issues, contributing to high customer satisfaction scores.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Advanced proficiency in LAN/WAN technologies, including configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent).
  

2\. Solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPN).
  

3\. Strong experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Cisco Prime).
  

4\. Indepth knowledge of ITIL processes and their application in network support operations.
  

5\. Good awareness of security best practices and data privacy standards in network environments.
  

6\. Ability to analyze and resolve technical issues independently and communicate solutions effectively within the team.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent certification is optional but valuable.
  

2\. ITIL Foundation certification is recommended.

title: Senior Engineer-DCS-Solar-BESS-Microgrid
description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
================================================

You will be responsible for complete Project Life Cycle i.e. starting from input analysis, Design \& Engineering, Testing \& Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) followed by commissioning as per requirement.


**Project Engineering:**

• Collection and review of project inputs from the Front Office or from the customer site through e\-mail, kick off meeting, site survey


• Execute DCS and SCADA based Solar/BESS/Microgrid greenfield and retrofit projects, Software and hardware engineering and configuration


• Guiding team to implement controls from SAMA, functional diagrams or functional descriptions; modifications of DCS/SCADA graphics; creation of faceplate macros, control macros and their testing


• Creation/modification of DCS internal point database; extraction of HW IO list from customer drawings; preparation of database; querying with HW team and customer for any clarifications needed


• Preparation and guiding the team on IO list and DBID; Experience of building blocks of DCS system like various Binary gates, A/M stations, PIDs etc. and their testing; Implementation of analogue and digital simulation logic for first pass and tie\-back simulation testing of implemented controls and graphics


• Configuration on 3rd party protocols, ELC and SLC communication


• Distributing the engineering work to system integrators; making adequate follow\-up for completion of project within budget, on/before time and with quality; Participation in kick\-off meetings (KOM), internal and external meetings of projects; Engagement in customer demos, FATs, SATs, and commissioning activities


• Experience with PSCAD and PSSE modeling to simulate and test power systems


• Should be able to do process testing of Solar/BESS/Microgrid plants and BOP, Working knowledge of industrial standards like IEEE, IEC, NEC, and Grid codes


• Ability to read electrical single\-line diagrams (SLDs), and switchboard control logic drawings; Should have experience with a variety of equipment and devices used in the renewable power plant including inverters, transformers, capacitor banks, Trackers, electrical equipment, IEDs, etc.


• Following department Quality \& HSE processes and procedures


**Field Services:**

• Ovation system power up, redundancy and I/O testing; Analogue and digital device testing and fault finding


• Maintaining protocols for loop check, device check and panel charging; Loop and device checking and necessary modifications in the logics, graphics, and database as per customer and site requirements


• Fault diagnosis of Ovation system, network system, and various communication interfaces like OPC, Modbus, DNP3, serial, IEC 61850, etc.


• Working closely with engineering team for troubleshooting of HW/SW (e.g. controllers, modules, link modules etc.)


• Solar/BESS/Microgrid plant commissioning for commercial operation; Travel to project sites for site assignments, testing and tuning of various electrical control functions, for third\-party communication and for commissioning

=================================

• Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Control \& Instrumentation, Power Engineering)


• Three (3\) to Eight (8\) years of experience in DCS/PLC programming / Engineering /


commissioning


• Ability to troubleshoot DCS/PLC control system

• Excellent language and communication skills; both verbal and written


• Ability to write reports \& business communication


• Ability to effectively present information and respond to queries from groups of managers,


clients, and customers


• Ability to interface with vendors \& sub\-contractors


• Should have good understanding of safety tools and gears, and safety guidelines of working at


site

================================================

• Good knowledge of Solar, BESS power plant process and KPI’s


• Good knowledge of Microgrid, electrical control functions and their required I/O signals


• Knowledge of electrical equipment like switchboards, generators, turbines, AVRs, motors,


transformers, capacitors, CTs, VTs, feeders, meters, relays

title: Site Engineer (Civil)/Site supervisor
description:
**Project Manager / Site Execution Manager – Retail Fit\-Outs**

**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.Tech in Civil or Electrical Engineering

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager / Site Execution Manager** with hands\-on experience in **retail and dark\-store fit\-outs**. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end site execution, vendor management, quality control and timely project completion.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand and interpret **MEP, fixture drawings and layouts**.
* Understand BOQs covering **complete civil and electrical fit\-outs** for dark stores, warehouses and retail stores.
* Conduct **site recce/surveys** and prepare BOQs as per approved layouts.
* Execute and manage **15–20\+ dark stores/retail stores** for corporate brands such as **Zepto, Blinkit, Zudio, Burger King**, etc.
* Coordinate and manage **vendor teams at site** to ensure timely project completion.
* Arrange vendors and manpower at short notice in case of urgent project requirements.
* Prepare **day\-wise execution plans** and ensure projects are completed within deadlines.
* Negotiate vendor costs and ensure execution **within the approved project budget**.
* Maintain close coordination with **client service teams, vendors and client Project Managers**.
* Obtain final **MB Sheet / WCC** sign\-off from the Client PM after project completion and submit the same for billing.
* Share **daily work progress reports** with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure **quality, snag\-free execution and adherence to project specifications**.
* Verify the **make/brand of materials** and ensure all items supplied are as per the BOQ.
* Handle site\-level escalations and resolve issues effectively.
* Ensure compliance with **safety standards and project\-specific requirements**.
* Maintain adequate **site stock/material availability** for smooth execution.
* Ensure complete **store readiness before opening**.
* Manage multiple projects and work effectively under pressure to meet strict deadlines.
* Willingness to undertake **Pan\-India travel** as required.

Desired Skills

* Strong **vendor management and negotiation skills**.
* Good understanding of **retail fit\-outs, civil and electrical works**.
* Strong project execution and site management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work under tight timelines.
* Strong problem\-solving and escalation\-handling skills.
* **Established vendor network** across locations will be an added advantage.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
